title: JSSC 10+2 Inter Level JILCCE Online form 2026
postName: Jharkhand Inter Level Combined Competitive Examination (JILCCE-2026)
vacancyDetails: 326 Inter Level (10+2) posts under JILCCE-2026 across Jharkhand departments as per notification
qualification: Intermediate (10+2) from a recognized board; post-wise additional conditions as per JSSC notice

shortDescription: JSSC JILCCE Inter Level Online Form 2026 for 326 posts (10+2 level). Application dates extended – apply till 04 September 2026 at jssc.jharkhand.gov.in.
content:
Jharkhand Staff Selection Commission (JSSC) has invited applications for the Jharkhand Inter Level Combined Competitive Examination (JILCCE-2026) for 326 posts.

Originally applications were scheduled from mid/late July 2026; the commission has issued a date extension. As per latest reports, candidates can apply from around 05 August 2026 to 04 September 2026 (confirm exact window on official site).

Eligibility

  • Qualification: 10+2 (Intermediate)
  • Age: generally 18–40 years with category relaxations
  • Fee: ₹100 (Gen/OBC) | ₹50 (SC/ST)

Download extension notice and apply only via jssc.jharkhand.gov.in.
